module: Flowgraph node "Generic Mission Text" (category repeat_instant, duration): displays info in the "Generic Mission Data" app. Inputs: "title" (translation key), "txt", "icon" (info), "order", "category" (flowgraph), "style" (text, time or timemillis), "clear". Only one message per category. The time/timemillis styles convert seconds to MM:SS or MM:SS.mmm.
notes: If title and txt are nil or if 'clear' is true, the info is cleared (the whole list if category is nil).
The 'icon' pin is declared but never sent to the UI.

work.desc: Sends or clears the data via ui_apps_genericMissionData.setData and signals genericMissionDataChanged to the ui module.
